questions: Have you been having sudden involuntary movements or jerks?
Do these episodes cause you to suddenly lose strength or collapse while remaining conscious?
Are they triggered by laughter, surprise, fear, anger, or other strong emotions?
Can you suppress the movements temporarily?
Do the movements lessen or stop when you are distracted?
Are they triggered by a sudden sound or unexpected touch?
Have you had episodes of losing consciousness or being unable to respond?
During those episodes, do you stiffen or rhythmically jerk?
Have you bitten your tongue or lost bladder control during an episode?
Are you confused or unusually sleepy afterward?
Do you have excessive daytime sleepiness or uncontrollable sleep attacks?
Have you experienced sleep paralysis or vivid dreamlike hallucinations while falling asleep or waking?
Do you have persistent weakness, numbness, or tingling in an arm or leg?
Have you had trouble walking, keeping your balance, or coordinating your movements?
Have you had new problems with vision, speech, swallowing, or bladder control?
Did these symptoms begin suddenly?
Have they been progressively worsening?
Have you recently had a head, neck, or spinal injury?
Are you taking any medications or substances that could affect your nervous system?
Does anyone in your family have seizures, narcolepsy, or a similar movement disorder?
